headlines.description: Chelsea scored four times in 12 second-half minutes as Leeds suffered a Carabao Cup collapse to lose 6-3 in the third round at Stamford Bridge.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chelsea score 6 in second-half rally to stun Leeds

headlines.description: Arsenal's 16-year-old sensation Max Dowman added to his hype with a sparkling two-goal display to earn a 4-2 victory at Ipswich in the Carabao Cup third round.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dowman double helps Arsenal cruise past Ipswich

headlines.description: Alexis Mac Allister and Cody Gakpo -- whose futures appeared in doubt this summer -- both scored as Liverpool booked their place in the Carabao Cup fourth round with a 3-1 victory over Tottenham.
headlines.shortLinkText: Szoboszlai worldie seals Liverpool cup win over Tottenham

events.name: Brighton & Hove Albion at Manchester United

headlines.description: Manchester United surrendered a two-goal advantage in a shambolic 3-2 Carabao Cup collapse to Brighton & Hove Albion as loud boos rang around Old Trafford and pressure on boss Michael Carrick went up a notch.
headlines.shortLinkText: Man United suffer historic collapse in Carabao Cup

headlines.description: Teenager Floyd Samba stole the limelight with two debut goals as Manchester City eased into the Carabao Cup fourth round with a 5-0 victory over Norwich.
headlines.shortLinkText: Samba, 17, nets twice in winning Man City debut
